ML_BACKEND_URL.description: URL of the FastAPI ML backend (e.g. https://your-fastapi.onrender.com). Required for ML predictions in production.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key. Required for food scanning and AI workout plans.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret key for signing JWT tokens. Use a long random string in production.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string. Leave unset to use in-memory/localStorage fallback.
